results.title: Chelsea's Joao Pedro out of Brazil's friendlies against Australia, India with injury
results.description: Sept 17 : Chelsea striker Joao Pedro has withdrawn from Brazil's friendlies against Australia and India due to injury, the national team said on Wednesday.The 24-year-old played the full game for Chelsea in a 2-2 draw with Hull City in the Premier League on Saturday, scoring one goal and setting up another.Brazil did not specify the nature of Joao Pedro's injury but said in a social media post that Fluminense midfielder Matheus Martinelli had been called up as his replacement.Brazil will visit Australia for two friendlies on September 25 and September 29, before playing India in Kolkata on October 3.

results.title: ‘Salary Cap Is Laughable at This Point,’ ‘How Is This Allowed?’ — NBA World Sounds Alarm As LeBron James’ Polymarket Endorsement Dwarfs 76ers Contract
results.description: Expectations are mixed regarding LeBron James’ first season with the Philadelphia 76ers. Many believe the newly constructed superteam has a strong chance to contend for an NBA championship, while others remain skeptical about the roster’s fit.

results.title: ActionAid launches project to strengthen mining communities
results.description: ActionAid Ghana has launched the Uplifting the Voices of Mining Communities (VOICES) project, aimed at strengthening the voice, agency and collective power of mining communities to participate meaningfully in decisions that affect their land, livelihoods and environment.
